SELECT p.*, pr.name AS producer_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_sales FROM products p JOIN product_seasons ps ON p.id = ps.product_id JOIN seasons s ON ps.season_id = s.id JOIN producers pr ON p.producer_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE ( s.start_month <= s.end_month
AND #{month} BETWEEN s.start_month AND s.end_month )
OR (
s.start_month> s.end_month AND ( #{month} >= s.start_month OR #{month} <= s.end_month ) )
GROUP BY p.id, pr.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
